items.title: Japan services producer prices jump 4.2% in October, firming the case for a BOJ hike
items.summary: A clear beat on services inflation adds weight to December BOJ hike pricing. That should offer the yen some support and nudge short-dated JGB yields higher, especially if upcoming wage data confirms the pass-through. The yen's response may be limited while the Fed is also on a hiking path , which keeps the rate gap with the US wide and USD/JPY elevated.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 服务业通胀明显超预期，为日本央行12月加息定价增添了砝码。这应能为日元提供一些支撑，并推动短期日本国债收益率走高，如果即将公布的工资数据证实了传导效应，情况尤其如此。由于美联储也在加息的道路上，日元的反应可能有限，这使得与美国的利率差距持续扩大，美元兑日元汇率也持续走高。
